# AppShots App Store Screenshot Generator

> AppShots is a free, open-source web tool for creating professional screenshots for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Drag-and-drop editor with multi-device layouts, cross-screen compositions, rich text, overlays, `.appshots` project files, and batch export.

Website: https://appshots.appstate.xyz
GitHub: https://github.com/BabiMumba/appshots
License: MIT

## What AppShots Does

AppShots lets mobile developers and marketers design polished store screenshots entirely in the browser. Select a device frame, upload app screens, add text and decorations, and export pixel-perfect PNGs (or a ZIP of multiple sizes). Everything runs client-side — no server uploads, no accounts, no watermarks.

## Core Features

### Device Frames
- Realistic mockups including iPhone 17 Pro Max / Pro / 17, iPhone 15 Pro Max / Pro, iPhone 14, iPad Pro 12.9", Pixel 9 / 9 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, Samsung Galaxy Tab S9
- Multiple frame colors per device
- Multiple independent devices per screenshot
- Cross-screen device overflow between adjacent screenshots
- Flat (2D) and 3D rendering modes with rotation controls
- Accurate camera elements (Dynamic Island, notch, punch-hole)

### Backgrounds
- Solid color, gradient presets (Sunset, Ocean, Mint, Berry, Royal, Rose), custom gradients, and background images

### Rich Text & Fonts
- Unlimited text overlays with rich formatting (bold, italic, underline, color, alignment, highlights)
- Google Fonts integration
- Drag-to-reposition and resize on canvas
- Inline editing on the canvas

### Overlay Images
- Upload badges, logos, decorations; laurel stickers in Overlays
- Drag, resize, rotate, layer order, per-image shadow

### Layout & Positioning
- Position presets, scale, offset, flat/3D rotation, device shadow
- Screen image zoom and pan inside the device

### Project Management
- Multiple projects: create, rename, switch, delete (with confirms)
- Autosave to localStorage
- Open / Save / Save as `.appshots` project files (Chrome/Edge can overwrite linked files with Ctrl+S)
- Dirty indicator only when a disk file is linked and unsaved

### Export
- Batch export: ZIP for multiple files, PNG for a single file
- Full App Store + Google Play size matrix (required and optional slots, including Play feature graphic)
- Loading state while exporting; success modal only after download completes
- Post-export success modal with optional project rename
- Cross-screen overflow and 3D preserved in exports

### Editor Experience
- Multi-screenshot gallery
- Empty device CTA: upload or drop an image onto the frame
- Undo/redo, keyboard delete/nudge, context menus
- Dark editor UI

## Tech Stack

- React 19, TanStack Router, Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide React
- Vite 7, Vitest, Bun
- JSZip, Canvas API
- No shadcn/ui — custom components under `src/components`

## Architecture

Single-page editor. State in `EditorContext`, autosaved to localStorage. Optional `.appshots` ZIP for portable projects.

### Key Modules
- `EditorContext` — projects, screenshots, selection, save/export
- `CanvasPreview` — canvas, cards, devices, overlays, text
- `DeviceFrame` / `DeviceFrame3D` — mockups
- `device-overflow` — cross-screen layout math
- `export-utils` — PNG/ZIP export
- `project-file` — `.appshots` IO + File System Access
- `ExportSuccessModal` — post-export rename/success
- `LeftSidebar` / `RightSidebar` / `ProjectSwitcher`

## Running Locally

```
git clone https://github.com/BabiMumba/appshots.git
cd appshots
bun install
bun run dev
```

Available at http://localhost:5173

## Export Sizes (examples)

| Preset | Dimensions | Store |
|--------|-----------|-------|
| iOS DI medium (required) | 1206 × 2622 | App Store |
| iOS DI medium | 1179 × 2556 | App Store |
| iOS DI large | 1320 × 2868 | App Store |
| iPad 13″ | 2064 × 2752 | App Store |
| Play phone (recommended) | 1080 × 1920 | Google Play |
| Play feature graphic | 1024 × 500 | Google Play |

See `src/constants.ts` `exportSizes` for the full matrix.
